sentences.text: Sam jeton në një shtëpi të vogël.
sentences.english: Sam lives in a small house.

sentences.text: Shtëpia ka një dhomë dhe një kuzhinë.
sentences.english: The house has a room and a kitchen.
In the room there is a table.

sentences.text: Mbi tavolinë ka një libër dhe një llambë.
sentences.english: On the table there are a book and a lamp.
Sam drinks coffee in the kitchen.
Then he reads in the room.

sentences.text: Dhoma e Samit është e vogël, por është e mirë.
sentences.english: Sam's room is small, but it is good.

sentences.text: Ardi shkon në shkollë me gjyshin.
sentences.english: Ardi goes to school with his grandfather.

sentences.text: Rruga e shkollës është e gjatë.
sentences.english: The road to the school is long.

sentences.text: Ardi ka një çantë të madhe.
Në çantë ka libra dhe bukë.
sentences.english: In the bag there are books and bread.

sentences.text: Ai është i lumtur, sepse sot ka shkollë.
sentences.english: He is happy, because today there is school.
Then the grandfather goes to the market.

sentences.text: Në treg ai pi kafe me Samin.
sentences.english: At the market he drinks coffee with Sam.

sentences.text: Ana ka një xhaketë të re.
Në rrugë është gjyshi i Ardit.
sentences.english: In the street is Ardi's grandfather.

sentences.text: Ai ka një çantë me bukë.
sentences.english: He has a bag with bread.

sentences.text: Sot ajo punon shumë, por nuk është e lodhur.
sentences.english: Today she works a lot, but she is not tired.

sentences.text: Rruga e klinikës nuk është e gjatë.
sentences.english: The road to the clinic is not long.
Sam does not have a family here.

sentences.text: Ardi, Elira, Ana dhe Luan janë shokët e Samit.
sentences.english: Ardi, Elira, Ana and Luan are Sam's friends.
